|lore=TIE fighters are stored in large racks far above the hangar deck. Catapulted into space by powerful tractor beam generators, TIEs can quickly scramble to engage the enemy.
|game_text=Take a device or a non-lightsaber weapon into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just initiated a battle or Force drain at a system or sector, deploy (as a ‘react’) an unpiloted TIE and a pilot of ability < 3 (simultaneously) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Sense.)

|notes=The remastered Players Committee slip for Emergency Deployment gives official text dated 4 December 2006. See [[Emergency Deployment (V) (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour) (Original)|Original]] for the earlier wording. Both slips retain the device or weapon search, paired deployment as a react and Sense immunity. The later slip spells out the opponent’s battle or Force drain trigger described by the [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=144 period react rule].
